title: Kel Ashar rebuilt
changes: Kel Ashar's mud-brick houses have ribbed walls, toothed parapets with horned corners, painted arched doors under striped awnings, and lattice windows.
Most houses raise an upper storey now, and their roofs are full of life: water jars, rugs, baskets of dates, firewood and palm-frond shades.
The town wall shows its brick courses and merlons, and has crumbled in places, with fallen bricks at its foot.
